source_statement_paraphrase: A boundary subset is reachable when every eliminated vertex has a directed path to some retained boundary vertex.

cnna_claim: The concrete C007 interior block is nonsingular, making the exact response domain total on reachable CNNA states.
cnna_hypotheses: DKP-2, compiler-verified DKP-3a, intrinsic birth-measurement grounding, exact unmodified C007 loopless-Laplacian convention.

source_statement_paraphrase: The Kron-reduced matrix preserves the loopy Laplacian class, and preserves the loopless class when the original matrix is loopless.

cnna_hypotheses: C007 source/out-degree loopless Laplacian; reachable boundary.

source_statement_paraphrase: A reduced directed edge exists exactly when the original graph has a path between the retained endpoints whose internal vertices are eliminated; strong connectivity is preserved.

cnna_hypotheses: Full C005 support strongly connected; M001 boundary reachable with at least two ports.
uncertainty_or_limit: The internal P001 proof does not import this published theorem as an axiom. It proves the required positivity from explicit positive paths in DirectedCutHypotheses, derives those paths for the canonical cut, and verifies reuse on an independent bidirected-chain cut family.
